architecture.description: what stands: the shape a system HAS, rather than one being proposed

design.description: a change being proposed: what it is, said in the doc beside it. `proposed` and `decided` carry the lifecycle

design_new.title: Propose a design
design_new.description: Write a change down so it can be argued with: an entity wearing design{} and doc{title, body}, put forward by the proposed mark. Who proposed it and when are stamped from the caller, never said on the line.

title.description: what it proposes, in a line

project.description: the project it is filed under

design_decide.title: Settle a design
design_decide.description: Record the decision on a proposal: approved, or declined. The decider is whoever is calling — stamped from the caller, so an agent's own decision is recorded as the agent's and an owner's only when the owner is the one asking.

verdict.description: approved, rejected, or approved once these changes are made

review.description: one reading of a design: the verdict, and the words beside it
